ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white) pixel concentrations localized at distal extremities and along portions of the trailing margin; approximate ratio of 3:1 black to white.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling is concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. Contiguous white patches are visible along the lower-medial edge of the right lobe. The central region near the peduncle connection is composed of solid low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute-angled V-shaped depression centered at the fluke midline with an approximate vertex angle of 80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire trailing edge, with increased amplitude and jaggedness at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit an upward convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel aggregates detected at both the left and right distal tips, appearing as dense white-on-black spotted patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct high-intensity linear pixel strings; a prominent diagonal scratch is visible on the left lobe, and multiple shorter, sub-parallel marks are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured, high-relief protruding clusters are visible at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, suggesting epibiotic colonization.
